title: Stability for the Anti-Ramsey Number of Matchings
summary: Let $n, r, s$ be three positive integers such that $n\geq 2s+5$. Let $K_r$ denote the complete graph of order $r$. Given a graph $F$, the anti-Ramsey number $ar(n,F)$ is defined as the minimum number $C$ such that any edge-coloring of $K_n$ with exactly $C$ colors contains a rainbow copy of $F$. Let $H$ be an edge-colored graph on $K_n$ with at least $g(n,s)$ colors, where \[ g(n,s)=\max\left\{ \binom{n}{2} - \binom{n - s + 1}{2} + 5, \binom{2s - 1}{2} + n + 1 \right\}. \] In this paper, we establish a stability type result for the anti-Ramsey number of matchings.
